description: This file is a React component for a web application, specifically implementing the client-side UI for uploading documents, managing upload categories, initiating persona build workflows via API calls, and handling user interactions related to document ingestion and persona generation.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a random string ID for file and upload item identification.

.name: getFileExtLabel
.description: Extracts and formats the file extension label from a filename.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Provides a human-readable label for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Provides the display title for a specific upload category section.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns the color accent associated with each upload category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns the accepted file extensions string for file input.

methods.name: IngestionClient
methods.description: Main React functional component managing document uploads, workflow initiation, and UI states for persona building.
